title: NRC Task 5 — stucco water entry and drainage/retention measurements for wall drainage assemblies
jurisdiction: NRC Construction research, Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (research only; no permit jurisdiction)
code_edition: 2010 NBC is the study comparator only; a project edition is unknown.

facts.text: The research project developed one benchmark wall assembly and eleven client wall assemblies to study drainage components and sheathing membranes under climate loads.

Task 5 reports laboratory water-entry measurements through stucco and at deliberate deficiencies, cavity-depth measurements, drainage/retention tests, and drying of a saturated NBC-compliant stucco plate.
Measured component data were used as moisture-load inputs to numerical simulations; the report identifies 2010 NBC capillary-break alternatives as the study context.
